description: This file contains unit tests for the class 'JsonValueFieldDefinition' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.json'. It tests immutability, equality, null safety, getter methods, marker management, string representation, and value mapping functionalities of the class.

classes.name: JsonValueFieldDefinitionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for 'JsonValueFieldDefinition' ensuring correctness of its behavior and immutability.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup, specifically an empty array of known field markers prior to each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of 'JsonValueFieldDefinition' are immutable using Mutability Detector.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of 'equals' and 'hashCode' implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that creating a new instance with a null pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullValueType
methods.description: Ensures that creating a new instance with a null value type throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that 'getPointer' returns the pointer initialized during creation.

methods.name: getValueTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that 'getValueType' returns the correct class type of the value.

methods.name: getMarkersReturnsUnmodifiableSet
methods.description: Tests that 'getMarkers' returns a set that cannot be modified, enforcing immutability.

methods.name: tryToInvokeIsMarkedWithOnlyNullMarker
methods.description: Ensures that invoking 'isMarkedAs' with null marker throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsTrueIfDefinitionContainsAskedMarkers
methods.description: Verifies that 'isMarkedAs' returns true when the definition contains all specified markers.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsFalseIfDefinitionContainsNotAllAskedMarkers
methods.description: Checks that 'isMarkedAs' returns false if not all indicated markers are present.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsTrueIfDefinitionContainsAskedMarker
methods.description: Verifies 'isMarkedAs' returns true if the definition contains a specific marker.

methods.name: stringRepresentationContainsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the 'toString' output contains key attributes and markers.

methods.name: tryToMapJavaNullValue
methods.description: Checks that mapping a null value throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: mapJsonNullLiteralWithJsonObjectFieldDefinitionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Maps a JSON null literal using a JSON object field definition and expects null.

methods.name: mapJsonArrayWithJsonArrayObjectFieldDefinitionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Maps a JSON array using a JSON array field definition and expects the same array back.
